caveats: Raw daily files beyond the 1000-entry directory listing cap were fetched by direct path; all 4120 needed days were used. Sea cells = 3301 of 3600 region cells (finite on all target days). Per-cell MHW gap joining: consecutive >=5-day hot runs separated by 1-2 days (all non-MHW) were merged. Smoothing uses plain mean (no NaN handling); no sea cell had NaN thresholds. Mask lists all 92 target days; land cells are 0.
